  • Method Details

    • generateToken

      @PostMapping("/generate-token") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> generateToken(@RequestBody JwtRequest jwtRequest)
      Authenticates a user and generates a JWT token upon successful login.

      This endpoint accepts a JwtRequest containing the username and password, attempts to authenticate the user, and returns a JWT token if authentication succeeds. In case of authentication failure, appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages are returned:

      • 404 - User not found
      • 403 - User account is disabled
      • 401 - Invalid username or password
      • 500 - Internal server error for unexpected exceptions
      Parameters:
      jwtRequest - the login request containing username and password
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing either a JwtResponse with the token or an ErrorResponse with the corresponding error message

    • getCurrentUser

      @GetMapping("/current-user") public User getCurrentUser(Principal principal)
      Retrieves the currently authenticated user.

      This endpoint uses the Principal object provided by Spring Security to obtain the username of the logged-in user. It then loads the user details from the UserDetailsService and returns the corresponding User object.

      Parameters:
      principal - the security principal representing the authenticated user
      Returns:
      the User entity corresponding to the authenticated username
